channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap outlining seven phases for the upcoming version was documented, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: A submodule related to GQHSM was removed from the AI system and its documentation was updated, and the backup component received upgrades to better track storage gaps and logging. Cold‑storage garbage collection was improved to keep seal markers during eviction. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: New lockout scenarios and related calculations were added to the investor tools, with formatting fixes and additional tests. The SDK gained a payout address function and improvements for self‑hosted runners, and a numeric keypad component was introduced for the API client scaffolding. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone audit was completed and documentation was updated, while the wallet now reports actual job counts. New payout address getters were added to accounts and nodes, and support for idempotency keys was added to API requests. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: The SDK introduced service registration, rotating refresh tokens, and password hashing for user creation, with documentation added. Build processes were adjusted to require self‑hosted runners, and the dashboard received design and accessibility improvements. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was improved by hashing passwords on creation and adding an email index, and tests were added to verify these changes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
